title: Splitting a String into a String[] Array
description: Break a sentence into an array of words with str.split(" ") and pass the resulting String[] array to printArray.

steps.description: Define printArray(String[] arr) to loop i from 0 to arr.length - 1, printing each element arr[i] followed by a space and newline.
In main, store the sentence in str, call str.split(" ") on line 12 to divide it at every space into String[] words, and pass words to printArray.

steps.question: When str.split(" ") splits at spaces, what is stored at words[4] and words[8]?
steps.answer: Because split(" ") only separates on spaces, attached punctuation stays with its word: words[4] is "jumped;" and words[8] is "dog.".

steps.description: Inspect the 9-element words array passed into printArray as the loop begins at i = 0.
